initialization: Same-seed F10 rehearsal with reset Adam. Uniform control reuses the exact sealed F15 imitation checkpoint (2048 BC steps); it is not retrained. Balanced receives exactly2048 new steps from the same F10 initialization. Accumulated BC budgets,512-demo training corpus, old64-row sampling, architecture and NLL/Adam kernel match; only new-demo sampling differs. No PPO or value-only updates.
sampling: In each128-row batch sample32 normal moves,16 Tera moves,8 voluntary switches and8 forced/revival switches from the sealed F15 train dataset. For each family choose games uniformly then one family row per selected game uniformly; shuffle64 rows and add64 old F7 samples using the same f15-old-sample keys as the sealed control. Outcome data never enter sampling. Classes derive only from teacher action ID and own-player request phase.
evaluation: Fresh128 development teacher games and128 fresh paired team/mechanics clusters per opponent in both seats, three endpoints and three seeds. Probe/eval exact teams must be mutually disjoint, train/development partition separated, and disjoint from F15 probe/eval. No label-based balancing of evaluation; all outcomes retained. Teacher metrics use equal-game and decision weighting within each family. All512 familiar F10 tactical probes repeated at all9 endpoints.
gate: Coverage is a descriptive operating-point screen, not a statistical strength claim: balanced Tera equal-game accuracy>=.25, gain over uniform>=.10, mass>=.15; voluntary switch accuracy>=.25; ordinary move and forced-switch accuracy drops<=.05; all32 known contexts retained. Missing minimum fresh probe support fails the run without resampling. Strength gate: balanced versus BOTH uniform and initial tactical >=5pp plus positive adjusted-bootstrap lower bound, no detected other-opponent regression, <=5% cutoff each final cell and known-context retention. Keep all27 paired contrasts. Each overall gate requires all3 seeds.
interpretation: Exploratory development confirmation of an adaptively chosen rare-action balancing hypothesis. Fresh F16 coordinates and exact-team separation from F15 development, within existing R7 partitions; recurring mechanics/species and known opponents. Teacher agreement is not optimal action truth. 128-pair percentile bootstrap coverage is approximate; retain Hoeffding bounds and unresolved cutoffs. Uniform control has sealed historical training, but exact same corpus, initial weights, runtime/kernel and accumulated training budget. F10 remains reference pending broader evidence. No automatic second experiment or budget expansion.
verification: Freeze sources/runtime/plan. Fresh replay of all128 new teacher games/data,6144 balanced updates,6912 evaluation games,4608 tactical predictions and9 teacher-probe endpoints;12 checkpoint comparisons,3 original next-update recoveries and3 sealed uniform-control load verifications.
